label: automixis
definition: A reproductive phenotype in which the reduction of reproductive nuclear ploidy is prevented or compensated and progeny derive their reproductive nuclei solely from products of one meiotically dividing cell or their descendants.
observations: Broad automixis; fusion and non-fusion routes.

label: autogamy
definition: A sexual-reproduction phenotype in which two meiotically derived gametic nuclei formed within one unpaired, undivided cell fuse with each other, without fusion of separate gametes.
observations: Existing ID; v501 supersedes standalone parent assertion.

label: cytogamy
definition: A sexual-reproduction phenotype in which a paired cell self-fertilizes by fusion of its own gametic nuclei without exchanging gametic nuclei with its partner.
observations: Existing ID; v501 supersedes standalone parent assertion.

label: paedogamy
definition: A sexual-reproduction phenotype in which two gametes produced by division within a single gametangium fuse with each other.
observations: Existing ID; v501 supersedes standalone parent assertion.
